description: Address v2 code review findings: add missing bar-mode transform tests (HeikinAshiTransformerTest, CandleRenkoBuilderTest) and fix disconnect() to clear persisted accountId.
steps: Create HeikinAshiTransformerTest.kt with tests for empty input, single candle HA values, multi-candle HA open chaining, and timestamp preservation.
Create CandleRenkoBuilderTest.kt with tests for empty input, invalid brickSize, insufficient move, bullish bricks, bearish bricks, and volume accumulation.
Fix Mt4RepositoryImpl.disconnect() to also call appPreferences.setMetaApiAccountId(null).
acceptance_criteria: HeikinAshiTransformerTest covers empty, single, multi-candle, and timestamp preservation
CandleRenkoBuilderTest covers empty, invalid brickSize, insufficient move, bullish, bearish, and volume accumulation
Mt4RepositoryImpl.disconnect() clears both in-memory and persisted accountId
No MockK, no android.* imports, no TODOs/placeholders in tests
verification: Source-level review: test files exist and assert real computed values
findings: Both v2 review issues resolved. HeikinAshiTransformerTest covers empty, single candle, multi-candle chaining, and timestamp preservation with hand-computed expected values. CandleRenkoBuilderTest covers all edge cases including volume accumulation. Mt4RepositoryImpl.disconnect() now calls appPreferences.setMetaApiAccountId(null) to clear persisted state. No android.* imports, no MockK, no TODOs. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY environment prevents running Gradle build/test, but source-level verification confirms correctness.
